guidance: This disclosure pertains to legal actions initiated under national or international laws designed
primarily for the purpose of regulating anti-competitive behavior, anti-trust, or monopoly
Anti-competitive behavior, anti-trust, and monopoly practices can affect consumer choice,
pricing, and other factors that are essential to efficient markets. Legislation introduced in many
countries seeks to control or prevent monopolies, with the underlying assumption that
competition between enterprises also promotes economic efficiency and sustainable growth.
Legal action indicates a situation in which the market actions or status of an organization have
